## 📝 Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## 🔗 Related Issue(s)
Closes # (issue number) or relates to # (issue number).

## 🧪 Type of Change
Please check the options that are relevant:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (no functional code was altered)
- [ ] Chore / Refactoring (non-functional optimizations)

## 📋 Quality Assurance Checklist
Before submitting this pull request, please make sure you have checked off the following tasks:
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and cleared all warnings/errors.
- [ ] My changes build successfully locally via `npm run build`.
- [ ] I have verified my modifications on all viewport sizes (Responsive layout is preserved).
- [ ] Any associated documentation (e.g., API_DOCUMENTATION.md) has been updated accordingly.
- [ ] No temporary/debug logs or secrets have been left in the codebase.
- [ ] I have updated the `CHANGELOG.md` to reflect these changes.
